name: unsafe fn from_encoded_bytes_unchecked (bytes : & [u8]) -> & Self
rule: For use as `bytes`, bytes from `OsStr::as_encoded_bytes` produced within the same Rust version built for the same target platform may safely be split immediately before or immediately after any valid non-empty UTF-8 substring.
api: impl  std::ffi::os_str::OsStr { unsafe fn from_encoded_bytes_unchecked (bytes : & [u8]) -> & Self }
